subject: Commercial path & security gating for Helium Health — post-call next steps
messages:
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
To: Katie Reynolds <katie.reynolds@heliumhealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 14 Nov 2026 15:03:00 -0700
Subject: Post-call recap + next steps — commercial path & security gating

Hi Katie / Tom —

Thanks again for the time today. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we have aligned expectations on procurement and security gating. High-level points from our call: 

- Commercial path options we discussed:
  • Invoice / PO (standard for billing to your AP team)
  • Credit card (faster, lower procurement overhead)
  • Cloud marketplace (AWS Marketplace) — useful if you need consolidated vendor billing and procurement templates, but onboarding time can be longer depending on marketplace registration.
- Security gating: Helium will need SOC 2 evidence and a signed DPA before procurement closes (I noted compliance is a blocker for AP to issue POs).
- Timing ask: You mentioned aiming to be live with a pilot by mid-December.

Action items I propose (feel free to edit):
1) Katie to confirm preferred commercial path (PO vs card vs marketplace) and share procurement contact + timeline for PO issuance.
2) Rishi (me) to share a short SOC 2 summary and our standard DPA for signature; also share a draft SOW for the pilot.
3) Ben to confirm whether a credit-card pilot pricing can be held for 30 days if you need time to route a PO.
4) Quick follow-up call next Tue (11/17) to confirm PO timeline or sign DPA/Docusign route.

Attachments: Helium_SOW_DRAFT_v1.pdf (pilot scope + pricing), SOC2-summary.pdf (controls overview).

If procurement wants a single owner to coordinate, who should I loop in? Tom or someone in AP?

Thanks —
Rishi

--
Rishi Malhotra
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
rishi.malhotra@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0194

From: Katie Reynolds <katie.reynolds@heliumhealth.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
Cc: Tom Alvarez <tom.alvarez@heliumhealth.com>
Date: Mon, 16 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0500
Subject: Re: Post-call recap + next steps — commercial path & security gating

Hi Rishi —

Thanks for the clear recap and the attachments. Short answers below: 

- Preferred path: PO / invoice is our default for new vendors for pilot spend > $10k.
- Procurement owner: Tom Alvarez (copied) will own PO routing and needs SOC 2 evidence + a signed DPA before issuing. He also asked whether Redwood supports SSO (SAML) and customer-managed KMS for key separation.
- Timeline: Procurement meets Thursdays; if we can get SOC 2 summary and a DPA to them before Wednesday (11/18), we should be able to get a PO approved by 11/25. If that slips, we may need to start on a temporary card to meet the mid-Dec pilot start.

Questions for you:
1) Can you share the full SOC 2 report or an auditor letter, or is the SOC2-summary.pdf the only artifact at this stage?
2) How soon can you send the DPA for signature (DocuSign preferred)?

We'd like to keep pricing and scope as discussed. If marketplace would speed things up, Tom will flag it, but he prefers PO.

Best,
Katie

--
Katie Reynolds
Head of Partnerships, Helium Health
katie.reynolds@heliumhealth.com | +1 (617) 555-0102

Rishi / Ben —

Good details. Quick internal plan:
- Ben: please confirm whether we can provide an auditor letter or full SOC 2 (PDF). If only a summary is available, note the date of last audit and contact info for auditor. Procurement loves an auditor letter.
- Ben / Legal: prepare the standard Redwood DPA in DocuSign and hold pricing per the SOW for 30 days.
- Rishi: if Tom will not accept DocuSign, we should surface marketplace as fallback. Ask Tom if AP requires vendor set-up forms — I can help fill those out.

If we can get SOC2 evidence + DPA out by EOD Wednesday (11/18) we should meet their PO timeline.

Marissa

1) DPA: I created a DocuSign envelope with our standard DPA and sent the invite to Katie and Tom (link: https://www.docusign.com/agreements/XYZ-9876543). Expect the email from DocuSign shortly. Please route to whoever signs vendor legal in your org.

4) Pilot SOW: attached Helium_SOW_DRAFT_v1.pdf. If the SOW looks good we'll lock pricing when DPA returned or PO issued.

Proposed meeting: 11/17 @ 11:00am PT to confirm PO status or DPA signature — I'll send a calendar invite.

Thanks — looking forward to moving this forward.

Rishi
